This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Kingster arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as active and playful. While in care, Kingster has been observed to be fearful and will balk when returning to kennel. When a sling is used Kingster will begin to head whip. In the kennel room, Kingster is also noted to fixate on the other dogs in the kennel room and begin growling. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Kingster
